in_sanskrit.name: Gattu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gattu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Gattu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘gatta’ which means ‘little’ or ‘small’. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with Lord Ganesha, who is often depicted as a child with a small, rotund body.

in_marathi.name: Gattu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gattu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gattu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘gatta’ which means ‘little’ or ‘small’. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with Lord Ganesha, who is often depicted as a child with a small, rotund body.
